video.title: How Work IQ Reasons Across Microsoft 365 Apps!

transcript.text: MCP is everywhere. Let me show you a
real enterprise example. So, this is a
demo environment containing emails, team
messages, meetings, documents, and
calendars. I asked Microsoft Work IQ one
question. What are Monica Thompson's
current commitment and can she take on a
new customer? Now, think about that
question for a second. This information
is not present in a single application.
Some information might be in her Outlook
mails or Teams chat. Something might be
discussed in meeting transcripts or some
information might be spread across
documents or calendars, which is hard to
track. But, within seconds, Work IQ
searched more than 100 meetings, emails,
chat messages, documents, calendars, and
everything to generate a decision-ready
answer. So, this entire process just
took seconds. The agent discovered
information across different Microsoft
365 systems and generated an answer
using live context. But, here's the
interesting part. Instead of hardcoding
hundreds of APIs, Work IQ exposes set of
tools that agents can use to find
information from multiple systems and
combine everything into a single answer.
So, that's the power of MCP. Subscribe.
